create_skeleton: create a Skeleton instance with joint offsets and parent indices for a kinematic chain
run_forward_kinematics: run forward kinematics on a Skeleton using quaternion rotations and root positions to compute world joint positions
remove_joints_from_skeleton: remove specified joints from a Skeleton and propagate their rotations along the kinematic chain in a dataset
compute_skeleton_metadata: compute skeleton metadata including has_children and children lists from the parent array
transfer_skeleton_to_cuda: transfer a Skeleton offsets tensor to CUDA for GPU-accelerated forward kinematics computation
